title: Evaluating the Evaluator: Measuring LLMs’ Adherence to Task Evaluation Instructions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the correlation between human judgments and prompt-free model perplexity compared to prompted LLM-as-a-judge evaluations (ranging from generic prompts to detailed rubrics) to evaluate if models inherently prefer text similar to their own fine-tuning data rather than strictly following explicit evaluation instructions.
